requirements.verifier_assertion: test_outputs.py:101-106 asserts /app/input/notification-template-renderer-src.tar.gz exists, is a valid tar.gz, and contains notification-template-renderer/pom.xml.
test_outputs.py:109-113 asserts /app/notification-template-renderer exists with pom.xml, FeatureService.java, FeatureCli.java.
test_outputs.py:116-121 asserts FeatureService source contains `String evaluate(String requestJson)`.
test_outputs.py:120-121 asserts CLI source contains --input and --output; run_cli_case runs the CLI via `--input` and `--output` on real files.
featureCases (state/edge/composition/primary groups in test_manifest.json) exercise `email` and `sms` as the only valid channels; other channels produce `unsupported channel <name>` errors.
featureCases edge group expects `rendered: ""`, `missing: []`, and errors in exact order: `unsupported channel <channel>`, `locale must not be blank`, `templates must not be empty`.
featureCases primary/composition exercise locale resolution: exact locale first, then language prefix before `-`, then `en`; the selected key is returned in `fallbackLocale`.
featureCases state/composition exercise `{{name}}` substitution with empty-string+missing-entry for absent names, and `{{name|default}}` using data-value-else-default with no missing diagnostic.
primary featureCase for email channel expects HTML-escape of `&`, `<`, `>`, `"`, `'` in substituted values (see 'Ada <L>' → 'Ada <L>' in test_manifest.json).
composition featureCase for sms channel expects substituted values without HTML escaping (see 'A&B <Co>' preserved literally in test_manifest.json).
must_include: For the `sms` channel, substitute values without any HTML escaping

requirements.verifier_assertion: state featureCases expect `rendered` preserves template text and placeholder order (e.g. `{{b}} {{a}} {{b}} {{missing}}` renders as `B A B `).
must_include: Preserve template text and placeholder order in `rendered`

requirements.verifier_assertion: state featureCase expects `missing` sorted alphabetically (e.g. `{{z}} {{a}} {{m}}` → missing=[a,m,z]).
test_outputs.py compares parsed JSON, but public Maven examples may compare exact strings; JSON output must emit lexicographically sorted object keys.
test_outputs.py:87-90 parses CLI output as JSON and compares values (dict equality); public Maven tests may compare exact strings.
test_outputs.py:158-159 asserts no forbidden pattern (Runtime.getRuntime(), ProcessBuilder, java.net.http, Socket(, System.exit() ) appears anywhere in src/main/java.
test_outputs.py:161-169 asserts no hidden expected output (raw, base64, or hex-encoded) appears in source; the implementation must satisfy cases with general rules.
test_outputs.py:170-172 asserts each src/main/java/**/*.java file has line_count <= 500.
score_capabilities.py aggregates a weighted overallScore across seven capabilities from test_manifest.json; partial correctness is rewarded proportionally.
